guard: a URL or host:port typed into `cotal up --host` is refused by name at the flag (pointing at --server) before any bracketing or registry comparison, and the --host/--server mismatch path prints its own diagnostic instead of throwing a raw Invalid URL (#1697)
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/up-refresh-identity-live.smoke.ts
why: The suite drives the shipped binary (`tsx bin/cotal.ts`), whose `@cotal-ai/*` imports resolve from `dist/`, so both the mutated run and the restore must rebuild — a stale build would grade the pre-change tree and report a vacuous verdict.

Each mutation removes exactly one limb of the fix (the URL refusal, the malformed-host refusal, the mismatch parse guard) while leaving the surrounding refusals live, so a green run after it means the suite observes some refusal rather than the one it names. The negative cells (`...not as a raw parse error`, `...not as the manual-record registry refusal it used to misfire as`) are what distinguish the fixed refusal from the two failure modes the issue reported.

mutations.name: let a URL through --host unbracketed-check (fall to bracketing)
mutations.expectRed: a URL passed to --host is refused
mutations.cell: a URL passed to --host is refused
mutations.command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/up-refresh-identity-live.smoke.ts
mutations.note: Removes only the scheme refusal; the malformed-host parse check below it stays live, so the URL cell must go red on the missing BY-NAME refusal (the bracketed literal `nats://[nats://…]:4222` parses true for `new URL` only if bracketing made a host of it — it does not: `http://[nats://…]` throws, so the fallback refusal fires with the WRONG message and the `looks like a URL` cells fail while the generic refused cell catches the exit-code change).

mutations.name: drop the malformed-host parse refusal
mutations.expectRed: a host:port spelling is refused as a bind host
mutations.cell: a host:port spelling is refused as a bind host
expectRedAlso: a URL passed to --host is refused even alongside --server
mutations.command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/up-refresh-identity-live.smoke.ts
mutations.note: With the scheme refusal still live, a `scheme://` URL is still refused by name; the `host:port` spelling alone loses its refusal and flows on as a silently bracketed `[127.0.0.1:4222]` literal. Compile-clean: `literal` is still assigned above.

mutations.name: revert the mismatch parse to an unguarded throw
mutations.expectRed: ...never a raw Invalid URL from the mismatch parse
mutations.cell: ...never a raw Invalid URL from the mismatch parse
mutations.command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/up-refresh-identity-live.smoke.ts
mutations.note: Unreachable through the two named host shapes (the scheme refusal exits first), so this mutant is graded by the guard's OWN cell surviving removal: the cell asserts the mismatch path never surfaces a raw `Invalid URL`, and with the try/catch gone the property it names has no enforcement site. If a future host shape reaches the comparison unparseable, the raw throw is exactly the regression this records.
